lines.japanese: 「おれは渡来さんと同じ大学に行きたいな」
lines.english: “I want to go to the same university as Watarai.”

lines.japanese: 僕は彼女の相手役として、恋人らしい台詞を吐いた。こういう本音を本人の前でさらりと口に出来てしまう僕の立ち位置は、果たして幸なのか不幸なのか。
lines.english: Playing the role opposite her, I delivered the sort of line a boyfriend would say. Was it good fortune or bad that my position let me speak the truth so lightly in front of the person herself?

lines.japanese: 「ふーん」
lines.english: “Hmm.”

lines.japanese: 渡来さんは素っ気なかった。彼氏役が演技したんだから、ちょっとぐらい合わせてくれてもいいのに。
lines.english: Watarai’s response was cold. Her pretend boyfriend had performed his part; she might at least have played along.

lines.japanese: 「ふふっ」
lines.english: “Hehe.”

lines.japanese: 「え、山科さん、なんで笑うの」
lines.english: “Yamashina, why are you laughing?”

lines.japanese: 「ううん。羽田君は一途だなと思って」
lines.english: “Nothing. I was only thinking how devoted you are.”
“What...?”

lines.japanese: あったかい笑顔で冷やかされて、急に恥ずかしくなった。そうだ、山科さんは僕と渡来さんの関係が嘘だって知ってるんだ。だから、僕の言葉が本音だって気付かれちゃったかもしれない。
lines.english: Her warm smile and gentle teasing abruptly embarrassed me. Of course: Yamashina knew my relationship with Watarai was a fiction. She might have realized I was speaking from the heart.

lines.japanese: 「え……？　あっ、いやっ、べつに……そういう、あの、意味深な発言じゃないし、おれ一途とか関係ないし」
lines.english: “What...? N-no, it wasn’t... I didn’t mean anything loaded. This has nothing to do with me being devoted.”

lines.japanese: 「一途なんだ？」
lines.english: “So you are devoted?”

lines.japanese: 「い、いや、だからぜんぜん、あの、だって、渡来さんなんか本当どうでもいいし」
lines.english: “N-no, that’s what I mean, not at all. I honestly couldn’t care less about Watarai.”

lines.japanese: 「なんだと」
lines.english: “What did you say?”

lines.japanese: 「あ、ごめ……じゃなくて、進路の決定とは関係ないって意味で……」
lines.english: “Sorry—no, I meant she has nothing to do with how I choose where to go...”

lines.japanese: 渡来さんが睨んでる。いったいどう言えば正解なんだろう。思わず視線を逸らしたら、その先で山科さんと目が合った。
lines.english: Watarai was glaring. What answer could possibly be correct? I looked away and met Yamashina’s eyes instead.

lines.japanese: 「言いたいことがあるなら自分で言いなよ」
lines.english: “If you have something to say, say it yourself.”

lines.japanese: いや、べつに山科さんに助けを求めたわけじゃないんだけど……。
lines.english: I had not meant to ask Yamashina for help...

lines.japanese: 「うん、じゃあ、また今度言うよ」
lines.english: “All right. I’ll tell you another time.”

lines.japanese: 頭をしぼった末の回答がこれだった。
lines.english: After wringing my brain dry, this was the answer it produced.

lines.japanese: 「二人きりのときに言うんだね」
lines.english: “When the two of you are alone, you mean.”

lines.japanese: 「もう……だからそういう、いやらしい言い方しないでよ。おれは純粋な気持ちで、渡来さんと同じ学校に行けたらいいなって言ってるだけなのに」
lines.english: “Honestly... Don’t make it sound dirty. All I said was that, with perfectly pure intentions, I’d like to attend the same school as Watarai.”

lines.japanese: 「だって」
lines.english: “That’s what he says.”

lines.japanese: 「……こういうところは嫌いじゃないんだけどな」
lines.english: “...Though I don’t dislike this part of him.”

lines.japanese: 渡来さんは誰に向けるわけでもなくため息をついた。僕は座り心地が悪い気がして、何度かお尻の位置を変えようと椅子を動かした。
lines.english: Watarai sighed to nobody in particular. Suddenly uncomfortable in my seat, I squirmed in the chair and shifted position several times.
